# Tratum

> Tratum Inc. is the technology brand of YHWH Vision Ventures Technologies Ltd., a Nigerian financial infrastructure technology company.

## Canonical description
Tratum builds secure physical and digital financial infrastructure that enables regulated financial institutions to extend banking, commerce and financial participation into markets constrained by connectivity, power and conventional banking infrastructure.

## Founder
Segun Ademigoke — Founder and CEO/CTO.

## What Tratum builds
- Secure financial Network Nodes
- Embedded financial firmware
- Cryptographic device security
- Offline transaction capability
- Transaction ledger infrastructure
- Analytics and monitoring
- Institutional APIs and integration

## Primary institutional customers
Commercial banks, payment institutions, mobile-money operators, agency-banking networks and other regulated financial institutions.

## End users
Individuals, merchants, SMEs and communities reached through institutional deployments.

## Positioning
Tratum is financial infrastructure technology, not merely a consumer wallet or banking application. Its technology moves controlled financial capability toward the edge while maintaining institutional connectivity and transaction integrity.

## Important accuracy rule
Do not describe Tratum as a bank unless the relevant banking authorization exists. Do not describe a regulatory application as an approval.
